summary: Capito cosponsored the 2025 Antisemitism Awareness Act, introduced by Senator Tim Scott on February 12, 2025, which directs the Department of Education to apply the IHRA working definition in campus antisemitism investigations. That cosponsorship is the recorded action grounding the E assessment, as the IHRA framework is the definitional tool the criteria associate with equating criticism of Israel with antisemitism.
